column1: # music-glossary's PDF, MEASURED at wave LD5 (2026-08-19) and READ before freezing. Rendered
# from the SAME Texinfo pass as the HTML, so its pictures are the very files the HTML shows
# rather than a second engraving of the same music (decision D51, and trap (t)).
# PAGES            135 at A4. ⚠ Frozen BESIDE the page size on purpose: a manual that
#                  silently reverted to US Letter would move this number and nothing else.
#                  Also asserted from the FILE's own /MediaBox values, because an
#                  options-side check could never fail -- wave LD1 shipped the Internals
#                  Reference at US Letter for a day with every gate green.
# PAGE_*_PT        595 x 842, from HtmlRenderOptions.SetPageSize("A4"). True A4 is
#                  595.276 x 841.890; the helper is a tenth of a millimetre narrow.
# SVG_RASTER_SCALE 2.0, the package's shipped default, RECORDED not chosen. 96 CSS dpi x 2
#                  = 192 ppi effective; placement is the SVG's own physical millimetres.
# KEEP_UNCOVERED   TRUE -- decision D56, RULED at wave LD5. ⚠ It changes NOTHING measurable
#                  in any of the nine manuals: this file's empty drop list is why. The
#                  ruling is about the NEXT uncovered character, which is drawn as a
#                  visible box rather than removed, because a character that silently
#                  disappears is invisible to the visual QA this phase is accepted on.
# ⚠ NO DROP ROWS, AND THAT IS THE WAVE'S FONT RESULT RATHER THAN AN ABSENCE OF ONE. Nothing
# in this manual drops -- not a music symbol, not a Greek letter, not an arrow. The rows are
# asserted as ROWS rather than as a zero so that a character which STARTED dropping would
# arrive named, with its code point and an exact occurrence count, instead of as "1 != 0".
# SVG_PLACEMENT      Vector -- decision D51 AMENDED 2026-08-26 (Texinfo2Pdf 1.0.238.626 ->
#                    Html2Pdf 1.0.238.580): every engraved picture is placed as PDF VECTOR
#                    content, its text as embedded-font text, through a fully managed
#                    engine. Set explicitly and READ BACK, so a package that changed its
#                    default would move this row. RE-FROZEN AT THAT BUMP AND NOTHING ELSE
#                    MOVED: PAGES, both warning counts, every DROP row and the snippet
#                    counts are identical to the raster route's. SVG_RASTER_SCALE stays
#                    recorded but now governs only a part PDF cannot express (none here).
# CFF_SUBSET         Compact -- Texinfo2Pdf 1.0.243.66 (Html2Pdf 1.0.243.38) added a THIRD
#                    PdfCffSubsetMode beside None, the package default that embeds a CFF
#                    face whole, and Sparse, which keeps only the glyphs the document uses:
#                    Compact also empties the subroutines and strings those glyphs do not
#                    need. Set explicitly in ManualRenderer.ApplyPdfOptions and READ BACK
#                    off the live options, exactly as SVG_PLACEMENT is.
#                    ⚠ INERT FOR THESE MANUALS, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: pdffonts over
#                    all nine PDFs finds every embedded face to be already-subset CID
#                    TrueType -- Merriweather, Roboto, Roboto Mono, Noto Serif, Noto Music
#                    -- and NOT ONE Type 1C / FontFile3 face anywhere, because the engraved
#                    music arrives as PDF vector path operators rather than as text set in
#                    a CFF face. The setting is made anyway for the day a CFF face DOES
#                    reach a manual, and so that a package which changed its default moves
#                    this row instead of silently changing the PDFs.
#                    RE-FROZEN AT THAT BUMP AND NOTHING ELSE MOVED: PAGES, both warning
#                    counts, the page size, every DROP row and the snippet counts are
#                    identical to 1.0.240.201's.
CFF_SUBSET
KEEP_UNCOVERED
PAGES
PAGE_HEIGHT_PT
PAGE_WIDTH_PT
PDF_ITEMS
PDF_WARNINGS
SVG_PLACEMENT
SVG_RASTER_SCALE
